sentences.text: The Gold Loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment charge percentage.

The FAQ instead says a gold loan is granted against pledged gold ornaments, the loan amount is a percentage of assessed value within the applicable loan-to-value ceiling, the tenure is up to 12 months, and interest is charged at the rate applicable on the date of the loan and on the daily balance.
I did not find any gold-loan FAQ provision on pre-payment charges or a pre-payment charge percentage.
